one_line: A parent's goal in the first words, then a hands-only demo where each spoken claim is visible on the crayon.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 extreme close-up of Giotto Cera Bicolor crayons in their box. Said (transcript): "מחפשים פעילות שתכין את הילדים שלכם..."; subtitle "מחפשים פעילות שתכין את הילדים שלכם" then "לכיתה א'?" (0:03) and "עצרו כאן ותצפו עד הסוף" (0:04).
q1_hook.why: It names a parent's seasonal goal in the first words, with voice and subtitle in step (H1, H6, T3, K6), and the branded crayons fill the first frame (S1, H3, F4). "Stop and watch to the end" is a request, not a held-back answer (H5). No face (H4).

beats.what: Crayon tips in extreme close-up; "מחפשים פעילות שתכין את הילדים שלכם לכיתה א'?"
beats.why: The goal and the product in one frame.

beats.what: Cut to top-down: a child's hands colour outlined Hebrew letters; "עצרו כאן ותצפו עד הסוף"
Colouring; a double-ended crayon shown at both ends; "12 צבעים", "24 גוונים שונים"
beats.why: The spoken claim is visible in the hand.

beats.what: A box of markers, then tracing with a black marker; "אפשר ללמוד בצורה חווייתית"
beats.why: A second product and a new action.

beats.what: Black lines join the coloured letters; "חשוב להשתמש בצבעים איכותיים", "ואז הילדים יוצאים מרוצים"
beats.why: One repeated action under three claims.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "אם אתם רוצים את הדף תגיבו בסרטון ואשלח לכם". Nothing in the video asks to comment, send or save.
q2_flow.why: A cut every 2.8 s on average, with claims said as the child colours, keeps a 31 s demo moving (R3, E2). The 0:19 to 0:30 stretch is one repeated tracing action under three claims with no new feeling (R1). It ends on a claim, not a payoff (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: the last spoken line is "ואז הילדים יוצאים מרוצים מהפעילות". Caption: "אם אתם רוצים את הדף תגיבו בסרטון ואשלח לכם", with no fixed word.
q3_cta.why: A purposeful offer, the printable page, and one action (C1, C2). But it sits only in the caption, and the video ends on a claim with nothing said or shown (C6). "Comment on the video" has no keyword, so it is hard to automate (C3).

q4_shown.what: Giotto Cera Bicolor crayon tips in extreme close-up; a child's hands colouring outlined Hebrew letters; a double-ended crayon shown at both ends; a Turbo Soft Brush marker box; tracing with a black marker. Both product names readable. No face, price or finished result.
q4_shown.why: Both products are named on the packs and used on a real page (S1, K5). The double-ended crayon is shown at both ends, so the 24-shades claim is checkable by eye (K4). There is no reaction or first-person use, only the narrator's word (S6). Hands only keeps the child off screen (S4, S5).

q5_edit.what: 11 shots in 30.6 s, 2.8 s average, straight cuts at 2.5, 4.6, 7.0, 12.8, 13.9, 16.0, 20.5, 25.2 and 28.5 s. Voiceover with two-line subtitles in step. Fixed top-down frames, no speed change seen. Ends on the child drawing, no end card.
q5_edit.why: A cut every 2 to 3 s between close and top-down views gives a moderate pace without scene jumps (E2, R3). Synced subtitles work muted (E4, T1), though near-verbatim (T2). It stops right after the last claim (E8), with no payoff (R4).

q6_topic.what: A summer activity to prepare for first grade: colouring and tracing Hebrew letters with Giotto crayons and markers. Serves a parent preparing a child for school.
q6_topic.why: Readiness for first grade is a dated parent concern and a buying moment, and the holiday suits an at-home activity (K6, K7). "Learn and practise" is a modest claim (K4). The benefits spoken are about the product, not a feeling (K1, K5).

q7_filmed.what: A macro shot of crayon tips for 2.5 s, then static top-down phone shots on a wooden table in daylight: a child's hands colouring and tracing on a printed page, the crayon box in the corner. No face.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands with the product in frame is the first-choice, child-face-free format (S4, F5, S5), and the macro makes the brand readable (F4). Even daylight, steady phone (F7). Full 9:16, sharp (F1, F3). Subtitles at about 78% down are in the bottom 35% (F2, T4).

q8_text.on_screen: White two-line subtitles with a dark outline, about 78% down, near-verbatim to the voice: "מחפשים פעילות שתכין את הילדים שלכם" (0:00), "לכיתה א'?" (0:03), "עצרו כאן ותצפו עד הסוף" (0:04), "12 צבעים שאפשר להכניס לקלמר של הילדים" (0:05), "שהם בעצם 24 גוונים שונים" (0:08), "עם חומרי היצירה של GIOTTO" (0:13). No headline, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "פעילות לחופש הגדול". Seven short lines, about 35 words: first grade and the letters with Giotto, "אפשר גם ליצור וגם ללמוד!", the offer of the page, and "בשיתוף @giotto_israel" on the last line. No hashtags.
q8_text.why: Synced subtitles read muted, but they repeat nearly the whole voice (T1, T2), sit in the bottom 35% (T4, F2) and put Latin "GIOTTO" mid-line (T6). The caption opens with the occasion, gives the offer and says "בשיתוף" in words, but on the last line, under "more" (T7, S7, T8).

weak_points: "Stop and watch" with nothing held back; near-verbatim subtitles in the bottom band; the CTA only in the caption and with no keyword; "בשיתוף" on the last caption line; no reaction; benefits about the product.
lumebook_takeaway: Film top-down hands on the product, name the parent's goal in the first line, show each claim in its own shot, and put the comment word on screen.
not_verified: Who the child is; music (none evident); what the finished page looks like (the tracing shapes are unclear); whether the partnership was paid (a co-author is listed, no label, "בשיתוף" in the caption). Corrections to the first pass: subtitles sit at about 78% down, lower than "lower third"; the machine transcript "לחיטה א'" is a mishearing of "לכיתה א'". Plays 3,872, likes 16, comments 42 on 15 Oct are context only. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
